world.title: 'Iran Is Targeting Americans': Nikki Haley Claims Assassination Plot Against Her By Pakistani Businessman
world.summary: Nikki Haley has claimed that Iran plotted her assassination through a Pakistani businessman associated with the IRGC. She warned that Tehran is actively targeting Americans within the United States. Haley, a former US ambassador to the United Nations, raised concerns about the implications of such threats, emphasizing the need for vigilance regarding Iran's actions against American citizens.

world.title: US Consumer Price Index rises 0.4% MoM in October vs. 0.3% expected
world.summary: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 0.4% in October, surpassing the expected 0.3% increase, according to the US Bureau of Labor Statistics. This monthly inflation rate follows a 0.6% rise in September. The data indicates ongoing inflationary pressures in the economy, as consumer prices continue to trend upward beyond market forecasts.

world.title: 12 Killed In Bulgaria Motorway Pile-Up Due To Fog
world.summary: Dense fog on a motorway in eastern Bulgaria caused multiple vehicle crashes, resulting in at least 12 fatalities and numerous injuries on Tuesday. The accidents occurred on the route connecting Sofia to the Black Sea port of Burgas, leading to the closure of the road in both directions. Authorities are investigating the incidents and assessing the situation.

business.title: New Hyundai Creta Interiors Spied - More Space, Features
business.summary: The new-generation Hyundai Creta's interiors have been spotted ahead of its launch in India, showcasing enhanced space and features. Notable additions include an electric Boss Mode. The introduction of the Hyundai Bayon at Rs 10 lakh allows Hyundai to expand the Creta's size and equipment, aiming for a more premium offering with a higher price tag.

business.title: PHDCCI seeks scrapping of LTCG tax on equities, cut in STCG rate to 10%
business.summary: The PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI) has requested the Indian government to eliminate the long-term capital gains (LTCG) tax on equities and reduce the short-term capital gains (STCG) tax rate to 10%. The organization believes that rationalizing capital market taxation would promote long-term investments and enhance India's attractiveness as a competitive investment destination.

business.title: FPIs turn net buyers; invest Rs 53,739-crore in Indian equities in first 9 days of November
business.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have turned net buyers, investing ₹53,739 crore in Indian equities during the first nine days of November. The recent AI-led sell-off has positioned India as an appealing option for FPIs, which typically view the country as a non-AI trade. This influx of investment reflects changing market dynamics and investor sentiment towards Indian equities.

technology.title: Google DeepMind Uses AI to Formally Prove Signal's Encryption Is Secure
technology.summary: Google DeepMind researchers have utilized a multi-agent AI framework, AlphaProof Code, to create a machine-checked mathematical proof confirming that the encryption code for Signal's messaging protocol functions as intended. This achievement is presented as a significant advancement towards developing software that can be rigorously verified for security, enhancing trust in digital communication systems.

technology.title: This Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR is actually a McLaren 750S
technology.summary: S Klub LA has modified a McLaren 750S to resemble the iconic Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR, unveiling the transformation at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas. This unique project aims to pay homage to the legendary sports car while showcasing modern design elements. The creation has sparked interest and discussion among automotive enthusiasts regarding its unconventional approach.

technology.title: Meet The Real-Life 'Thing': The Robotic Hand That Walks On Its Finger
technology.summary: Scientists at ETC Zurich have developed a robotic hand that walks on its fingers, inspired by existing Chinese technology. This innovation enhances the functionality of the robotic hand, resembling the disembodied hand known as 'Thing' from popular culture. The project showcases advancements in robotics, aiming to create more versatile and useful robotic systems for various applications.

sports.title: No Olympic quota for Manu Bhaker, Esha Singh despite 25m pistol team gold at World Championships
sports.summary: India's Manu Bhaker and Esha Singh secured a gold medal in the women's 25m pistol team event at the ISSF World Championships. However, both athletes faced disappointment in the individual competition, finishing outside the medal positions. As a result, they did not qualify for the upcoming Los Angeles 2028 Olympics, missing the opportunity despite their team success.

sports.title: Ecclestone cameo clinches last-ball thriller for Adelaide Strikers
sports.summary: Hobart Hurricanes, led by captain Nicola Carey’s second consecutive fifty, faced their fifth straight defeat in WBBL 2026 after a last-ball loss to Adelaide Strikers. The match concluded dramatically with Sophie Ecclestone's brief but impactful performance, securing the win for the Strikers. Despite Carey's efforts, the Hurricanes continue to struggle in the tournament.

sports.title: Red Bull retain shock status as FIA make key 2027 F1 announcement
sports.summary: The FIA announced that Red Bull-Ford will not receive additional power unit development allowances for the 2027 Formula 1 season. This decision follows the latest ADUO assessment, which confirmed Red Bull's status as the benchmark for internal combustion engines earlier in the season. As a result, Red Bull will enter the season without further upgrades.

health.title: Kadak Sehat Samvad puts cancer screening and early diagnosis in focus on National Cancer Awareness Day
health.summary: Kadak Sehat Samvad, organized by Network18 on National Cancer Awareness Day, focused on cancer screening and early diagnosis. The event brought together doctors, healthcare professionals, and policymakers to discuss early warning signs, the importance of regular screening, timely consultations, treatment access, and addressing the stigma surrounding cancer. The initiative aimed to enhance awareness and improve health information accessibility.

health.title: Do boond zindagi ki: India hits immunisation milestones, but why are millions still missing their shots?
health.summary: India's vaccination drive, initiated with "do boond zindagi ki," has become one of the largest globally, achieving significant milestones like the eradication of smallpox and polio. Despite this progress, millions of children remain unvaccinated, raising concerns about access and awareness. Health officials continue to address these gaps to ensure comprehensive immunization coverage across the country.

health.title: How to help someone whose thinking seems delusional
health.summary: To assist someone with potentially delusional thinking, observe for signs of delusion, distinguishing them from anxiety-driven thoughts. Fixed beliefs may not require confrontation. Instead, engage with empathy and understanding. A clinical psychologist suggests a gentler approach, focusing on support rather than proving them wrong. This method fosters a more constructive dialogue and helps the individual feel heard.

science.title: Astronauts to return to Moon by 2028 in bid to build permanent presence
science.summary: NASA has announced plans to return astronauts to the Moon by 2028, aiming to establish a permanent presence. The strategy includes testing two lunar landers, improving rocket preparations, and developing a lighter spacesuit. This initiative is part of a broader effort to facilitate future human exploration of Mars, marking a significant step in lunar and interplanetary exploration.

science.title: 4 NASA volunteers complete 378-day Mars simulation, emerge after year in isolation
science.summary: Four NASA volunteers have completed a 378-day Mars simulation, emerging after a year of isolation. The experiment aimed to replicate conditions astronauts might encounter on Mars, including limited resources, prolonged isolation, and communication delays of 13 to 22 minutes. The crew faced various challenges designed to test their resilience and adaptability in a Martian-like environment.

science.title: Dead star is killing its Jupiter-sized 'Phoenix' planet that rose from its remains
science.summary: Astronomers have observed a unique phenomenon involving HS 0209+0832, a white dwarf star that has given rise to a Jupiter-sized planet, dubbed 'Phoenix.' This discovery challenges existing theories, as the planet formed from the star's remnants is now being destroyed by the star's gravitational influence. This process highlights the complex relationship between dying stars and their planetary systems.

entertainment.title: Kiara Advani reveals Karan Johar pushed Shahid Kapoor off the stage at her wedding with Sidharth Malhotra in new ‘Koffee With Karan 9’ promo
entertainment.summary: In a new promo for ‘Koffee With Karan 9,’ Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra discuss their wedding and married life. Advani reveals that Karan Johar playfully pushed Shahid Kapoor off the stage during their wedding ceremony. The episode promises insights into the couple's relationship and experiences, highlighting the lighthearted moments shared among friends during the celebration.

entertainment.title: 'Ramayana' actor Indira Krishnan reacts to Sai Pallavi's fight sequence in the film: 'Never saw Sita as a warrior, no woman in our film is depicted as weak'
entertainment.summary: Indira Krishnan, known for her role in 'Ramayana', commented on Sai Pallavi's fight sequence, emphasizing that she never viewed Sita as a warrior. She highlighted that no female character in the film is depicted as weak. Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana: Part I', featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash, has surpassed Rs 600 crore globally.

entertainment.title: Karan Johar defends Vijay Deverakonda-Rashmika Mandanna against criticism over their relationship; slams those demeaning their family
entertainment.summary: Karan Johar defended actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna against criticism regarding their relationship following their February wedding. He condemned those who demean their families, emphasizing the importance of respect and support. Johar's remarks came during an appearance on "Koffee With Karan," where he addressed the public scrutiny surrounding the couple's marriage and the negative comments they received.
